responsibility: Provides shared trait-resolution utilities for canonicalizing and deduplicating predicates, elaborating child obligations with preserved environment and derived causes, and traversing only the transitive supertraits relevant to a requested associated item.
same_name_distinction: Unlike `error_reporting/infer/nice_region_error/util.rs`, which is a diagnostic helper for anonymous-lifetime region errors, this `util.rs` serves the trait-resolution side. It anonymizes and deduplicates predicates, builds derived child obligations during elaboration, and walks only the supertraits relevant to a requested associated item.
